notes.title: 【A fascinating story】Small update description!
notes.notes:
Some problems and bugs in the game have been fixed;

·Story text display garbled characters/numbers/random jumps, etc.

Fixed illustration display errors

Some buttons cannot be clicked

And adjusted and modified according to the problems that everyone has reported many times;

·After unlocking a single female character's five-heart favor and completing the final event of the current character, you can unlock all her memories (now a single archive can unlock all the content)

Now you can update and solve it. If you encounter other problems, you can send a private message to customer service for feedback. Thank you again for your understanding and love for us.
